title: Defi Pilot
tagline: Defi Pilot is your AI-powered crypto assistant for seamless portfolio tracking and smarter DeFi strategies. Monitor holdings, analyze performance, and get personalized insights—all tailored for 1inch users. Your trusted co-pilot in the world of decentralized finance.
description:
Defi Pilot is an AI-driven assistant powered by the Vercel AI SDK, designed to simplify crypto portfolio tracking for 1inch users. It allows users to seamlessly monitor holdings, analyze token performance, and receive actionable insights through an intuitive interface.

Defi Pilot delivers a user-friendly dashboard that aggregates wallet data, market trends, and performance metrics, helping users make informed decisions. With wallet connectivity and personalized recommendations, managing your DeFi strategies becomes effortless.

Focused on security and privacy, Defi Pilot ensures that all user data and interactions remain safe. The goal is to empower crypto enthusiasts with advanced tools, making decentralized finance accessible to everyone, regardless of technical expertise.
how_its_made:
Here's a breakdown of how it all comes together:

1. Vercel AI SDK:
Core Framework: The Vercel AI SDK is at the heart of Defi Pilot, enabling the creation of a responsive, conversational AI chatbot. This SDK streamlines the process of building and deploying AI-driven interfaces, ensuring the chatbot can handle user requests with high efficiency.

2. Blockchain Integration:
Viem: This library is used to interact with different blockchain networks. They allow the chatbot to fetch token balances, estimate gas fees, and execute transactions once the user connects their wallet.
Multi-Chain Support: Defi Pilot supports various blockchains (e.g., Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon etc...) by integrating with the 1inch API

3. User Interface (UI):
Next.js/React.js/Tailwindcss: The front-end UI is built using React.js, providing a dynamic and responsive interface
Wallet Integration: WalletConnect and MetaMask are integrated into the UI, enabling users to securely connect their crypto wallets and sign transactions directly within the app.

4. Hacky/Notable Features:
Dynamic UI Rendering: The chatbot dynamically generates UI components based on user input, making everything intuitive and reducing user friction.

5. Deployment:
Vercel: Defi Pilot is deployed on Vercel, leveraging its serverless architecture for scalability and rapid deployment.
